invariants.rationale: The method assumes 'result' is not null, as it is immediately dereferenced (result.getWriteStatuses()) without a null check.
The first operation on 'result' is result.getWriteStatuses().stream(), indicating that getWriteStatuses() is expected to return a non-null value.
This is always true for any list; included for completeness as a property of lists returned by getWriteStatuses().
